verdict.rationale: ADK ships its own built-in development web UI (`adk web`) described as helping developers "test, evaluate, debug" agents, which is first-party UI support for inspecting agent runs. The evidence never says this UI shows per-LLM-call or per-tool-invocation traces. Callbacks for logging and monitoring are only a building block for constructing tracing, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a trace view covering every LLM call and tool invocation, span/trace export or observability-platform integration, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace every LLM call and tool invocation of an agent run in an observability UI

citations.quote: A built-in development UI to help you test, evaluate, debug, and showcase your agent(s).
